```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Functions ------
#Function for GSEA with custom gene sets list
autoGSEA <- function(df, TERM2GENE, geneset_name) {
  gsea_results <- list()

  conditions <- df$condition %>%
    unique() %>%
    as.character()

  for (condition_i in conditions) {
    
    degs_condition <- df %>%
      filter(condition == condition_i) %>%
      dplyr::select(genes, log2fold_change) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      # mutate(rank = rank(log2fold_change, ties.method = "random")) %>%
      arrange(desc(log2fold_change)) %>% 
      deframe()

    auto_gsea <- tryCatch({
      GSEA(geneList = degs_condition,
           TERM2GENE = TERM2GENE,
           minGSSize = 1,
           maxGSSize = 1000,
           pvalueCutoff = 1,
           pAdjustMethod = "BH") %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        arrange(qvalue) %>%
        mutate(condition = condition_i,
               gsea_enrichment = geneset_name)
    }, error = function(e) {
      return(NULL)
    })

    if (!is.null(auto_gsea)) {
      key <- paste(condition_i, geneset_name, sep = "_")
      gsea_results[[key]] <- auto_gsea
    }
  }

  return(list(
    gsea = bind_rows(gsea_results)
  ))
}

#Function for GSEA (Gene Ontology database)
gseGO_all <- function(df, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", keyType = "SYMBOL", ontology = "BP") {
  all_conditions <- df %>%
    distinct(condition) %>%
    pull(condition)
  
  gsea_results <- lapply(all_conditions, function(cond) {
    message("Running for condition: ", cond)
    
    ranked_df <- df %>%
      filter(condition == cond) %>%
      arrange(value)
    
    gene_list <- ranked_df %>%
      arrange(-value) %>%
      pull(value, name = genes)
    
    gsea_result <- tryCatch({
      gseGO(
        geneList = gene_list,
        ont = ontology,
        keyType = keyType,
        pvalueCutoff = 1,
        verbose = TRUE,
        OrgDb = OrgDb,
        pAdjustMethod = "BH"
      ) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        arrange(qvalue) %>%
        mutate(
          condition = cond,
          geneset = "Gene ontology, BP"
        ) %>%
        clean_names()
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Error in GSEA for condition: ", cond)
      return(NULL)
    })
    
    return(gsea_result)
  })
  
  bind_rows(gsea_results)
}


#Function for ORA/ENRICHER custom
enricher_condition <- function(df, term2gene_df) {
  df %>%
    distinct(condition) %>%
    pull(condition) %>%
    set_names() %>%
    map_dfr(function(cond) {
      genes <- df %>%
        filter(condition == cond) %>%
        pull(genes)

      result <- tryCatch({
        enricher(
          gene = genes,
          pvalueCutoff = 0.50,
          pAdjustMethod = "BH",
          TERM2GENE = term2gene_df
        ) %>%
          as.data.frame() %>%
          clean_names() %>%
          mutate(condition = cond)
      }, error = function(e) {
        message("Failed on condition: ", cond)
        return(NULL)
      })

      return(result)
    })
}

# Function for ORA Gene Ontology
oraGO_condition <- function(df, orgdb = org.Hs.eg.db) {
  df %>%
    distinct(condition) %>%
    pull(condition) %>%
    set_names() %>%
    map_dfr(function(cond) {
      genes <- df %>%
        filter(condition == cond) %>%
        pull(genes)

      result <- tryCatch({
        enrichGO(
          gene = genes,
          OrgDb = orgdb,
          keyType = 'SYMBOL',
          readable = T,
          ont = "BP",
          pAdjustMethod = "BH",
          qvalueCutoff = 1) %>%
          as.data.frame() %>%
          clean_names() %>%
          mutate(condition = cond)
      }, error = function(e) {
        message("Failed on condition: ", cond)
        return(NULL)
      })

      return(result)
    })
}


# Function for clustering by day
cluster_by_day <- function(df, day_column = "day", condition_column = "condition") {
  
  # Obter os níveis do fator da coluna de dias
  days <- levels(df[[day_column]])
  
  # Inicializar uma lista para armazenar as ordens
  orders <- list()
  
  # Loop por cada nível (dia) da coluna fator day
  for (day_value in days) {
    # Filtrar os dados para o dia atual
    day_data <- df %>%
      filter(!!sym(day_column) == day_value) %>%
      dplyr::select(!!sym(condition_column)) %>%
      distinct()
    
    # Criar uma matriz binária onde 1 representa a presença da condição
    if (nrow(day_data) > 1) {
      # Matriz com condições como rótulos e 1 para presença
      presence_matrix <- table(day_data[[condition_column]]) > 0
      dist_matrix <- as.matrix(presence_matrix)
      
      # Clustering
      col_clustered <- dist(dist_matrix) %>% hclust()
      
      # Armazenar a ordem dos clusters
      orders[[day_value]] <- col_clustered$labels[col_clustered$order]
    } else {
      # Se houver apenas uma condição, armazenar o rótulo
      orders[[day_value]] <- as.character(day_data[[condition_column]])
    }
  }
  
  # Converter a lista de ordens para um data frame
  order_df <- data.frame(
    day = rep(names(orders), sapply(orders, length)),
    condition = unlist(orders)
  )
  
  return(order_df)
}
```

### Annotate genes
```{r}
## Set up biomart
ensembl_mart <- useMart("ensembl")
ensembl_mart <- useDataset("mmusculus_gene_ensembl", mart = ensembl_mart)

## Get the MGI symbol
gene_id <- GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2 %>% rownames()

#Get other annotations
listAttributes(ensembl_mart)

#Annotate
annot <- getBM(
  attributes = c("agilent_sureprint_g3_ge_8x60k", #Agilent microarray data (design ID 028005, retrieved from GEO)
                 "ensembl_gene_id",
                 "entrezgene_id",
                 "mgi_symbol",
                 "description"),
  filters = "agilent_sureprint_g3_ge_8x60k",
  values = gene_id,
  mart = ensembl_mart)

#Get annotations for each probe 
### Filter genes with highest median expression
GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2_summary = GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2 %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("probe") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -probe,
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(probe) %>% 
  summarize(mean = mean(expression,na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(expression, na.rm = T)) %>%  
  inner_join(annot %>% 
              rename(probe = agilent_sureprint_g3_ge_8x60k), 
            by = "probe") 

#Print out the annotated table
GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2_summary
```
Stats
- 39,430 probes in the microarray,
- 39,392 that were annotated in BiomaRt (~99.90%)
- 37,983 probes had a correspondent mgi symbol (96.33% of probes in microarray)
- 31,140 probes had a correspondent entrez id (78.97% of probes in microarray)
- 30,787 probes with entrez id also had a correspondent mgi_symbol (78.08% of probes in microarray)
- 22,435 probes have an entrez gene id. As this is the input in FIT, we used this to filter, not mgi_symbol (56.89% of probes in microarray)
- 21,744 genes were filtered by the highest median (55.14% were kept from the microarray)
- 86 Dupes. The duplication is due to different mgi_symbols. Same Entrez IDs can correspond to different mgi_symbol
- 20849 probes were used (52.87%)

### Differential gene expression
```{r}
#Import
GSE120661_expression_highest_median_probes %>% 
  saveRDS(here("tables", "GSE120661_expression_highest_median_probes_not_normalized_log2.rds"))
GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2 = 
  read_rds(here("tables", "GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2.rds"))
GSE120661_samples_pbmc = 
  read_rds(here("tables", "GSE120661_samples_pbmc.rds"))

#Filter vaccine
GSE120661_samples_pbmc_fluad = GSE120661_samples_pbmc %>% 
  filter(treatment == "Fluad")

GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2_matrix_fluad = GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2 %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(c(GSE120661_samples_pbmc_fluad$geo_sample)) %>% 
  as.matrix()

#Normalize quantiles
GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix_fluad <- normalizeBetweenArrays(GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2_matrix_fluad, 
                                                                   method = "quantile")

#Diagnostics
dim(GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix_fluad) #20845   35

dim(AnnotatedDataFrame(GSE120661_samples_pbmc_fluad %>% column_to_rownames("geo_sample"))) #35
    
#Create new Expression set with the filtered data
eset_filtered <- ExpressionSet(
  assayData = GSE120661_counts_normalized_matrix_fluad,
  phenoData = AnnotatedDataFrame(GSE120661_samples_pbmc_fluad %>%
                                   column_to_rownames("geo_sample")))

#Save
eset_filtered %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "GSE120661_eset_filtered.rds"))


#Create design matrix -------
design <- model.matrix(~ condition + 0, eset_filtered) # 0 defines the way we compare the samples
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  # Avoids blank spaces

# Estimate correlation between doses on the same individual:
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(eset_filtered, 
                               design = design, 
                               block = eset_filtered$subject_id)
corfit$consensus

# Use the correlation into the linear model
#Fit Limma model
fit <- lmFit(eset_filtered, design, 
             block = eset_filtered$subject_id, 
             correlation = corfit$consensus)
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)

#Test for Fluad -------
cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(conditionFluad_4_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             conditionFluad_8_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             conditionFluad_24_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             conditionFluad_48_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             conditionFluad_72_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             conditionFluad_168_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             levels=design)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix)
fit2 <- treat(fit2, lfc = 0.0)

#Get DEGs ------
## For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("probe")
    
})

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs
all_degs = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = str_replace(comparison, "\\.\\.\\.", "_") %>% 
           str_replace(., "timepoint", "Time") %>% 
           str_replace(., "treatment", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  mutate(comparisonRef = str_replace(comparisonRef, "treatment", "Time0")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparisonA == "conditionFluad_4_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_4_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionFluad_8_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_8_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionFluad_24_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_24_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionFluad_48_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_48_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionFluad_72_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_72_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionFluad_168_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_168_PBMC",
                               T~comparisonA)) %>% 
  select(condition, everything())
	
all_degs
```

### Gene annotation
- 27,317 genes in the input matrix
- 25,035 probes from DGE analysis (no lfc threshold)

About FIT genes:
- 16,425 genes in FIT analysis (including human and mouse genes)
- 16,417 unique mouse to human genes (are duplicated)
- 34 genes have either different hgnc symbol to mgi symbol, or the other way.
- 16 human genes are repeated because of different Entrez IDs
- 14,357 mouse genes in FIT are in the limma output. 
- 14,448 unique human genes 
- 223 mouse symbols correspond to the same or another human symbol

### Annotate features
```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, cache = TRUE}
# Annotate genes
probes_annotation <- read.delim(here("tables", "GPL21272-58809.txt"), skip = 19, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", quote = "") %>% 
  select(gene_id = ID, entrez_id = ENTREZ_GENE_ID, ensembl_id = ENSEMBL_ID, gene_symbol = GENE_SYMBOL) %>% 
  mutate(gene_id = as.character(gene_id))

GSE124689_counts <- GSE124689_exprs %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>% 
  inner_join(probes_annotation, by = "gene_id") %>% 
  select(gene_id, entrez_id, ensembl_id, gene_symbol, c(human_samples_pbmc_fluad$biosample_accession)) %>% 
  mutate(entrez_id = as.character(entrez_id)) 

#Get probes and entrez IDs with the highest median by ensembl_id
GSE124689_counts_genes_selected = GSE124689_counts %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(gene_id, entrez_id, ensembl_id, gene_symbol),
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(entrez_id, gene_id) %>% 
  drop_na(entrez_id) %>% 
  summarize(median = median(expression),
            median = round(median, 10)) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>% 
  ungroup()

#Merge
GSE124689_counts_raw = GSE124689_counts %>% 
  inner_join(GSE124689_counts_genes_selected %>% 
               select(gene_id, entrez_id),
             by = join_by("gene_id", "entrez_id"))

#Delete duplicates by sampling
dupes_entrez = GSE124689_counts_genes_selected %>% 
  get_dupes(entrez_id) %>% 
  group_by(entrez_id) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 1)

#Merge
human_fluadd_not_normalized = GSE124689_counts_raw %>%
  select(-gene_symbol) %>% 
  filter(!gene_id %in% c(dupes_entrez$gene_id)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(c(entrez_id, human_samples_pbmc_fluad$uid)) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("entrez_id") 

#Save
human_fluadd_not_normalized %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "GSE124689_expression_raw.rds"))

#Get symbols only
GSE124689_counts_genes_selected_symbol = GSE124689_counts %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(gene_id, entrez_id, ensembl_id, gene_symbol),
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "expression") %>% 
  group_by(gene_symbol, gene_id) %>% 
  filter(gene_symbol != "") %>% 
  drop_na(gene_symbol) %>% 
  summarize(median = median(expression),
            median = round(median, 10)) %>% 
  slice_max(median, n = 1) %>% 
  ungroup()

GSE124689_counts_raw_symbol = GSE124689_counts %>% 
  inner_join(GSE124689_counts_genes_selected_symbol %>% 
               select(gene_id, gene_symbol),
             by = join_by("gene_id", "gene_symbol"))

dupes_symbols = GSE124689_counts_genes_selected_symbol %>% 
  get_dupes(gene_symbol) %>% 
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 1)

human_fluadd_not_normalized_symbol = GSE124689_counts_raw_symbol %>%
  filter(!gene_symbol %in% c(dupes_symbols$gene_symbol)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(c(gene_symbol, human_samples_pbmc_fluad$uid)) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("gene_symbol")

human_fluadd_symbol_entrez = GSE124689_counts_raw_symbol %>%
  filter(!gene_symbol %in% c(dupes_symbols$gene_symbol)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(symbol = gene_symbol, entrez_id)

#Save
human_fluadd_not_normalized_symbol %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "GSE124689_expression_not_normalized_log2_raw_symbol.rds"))
```

```{r}
#Import datasets
GSE124689_expression_not_normalized_log2_raw_symbol = read_rds(file = here("tables", "GSE124689_expression_not_normalized_log2_raw_symbol.rds"))
GSE124689_metadata_clean = readRDS(file = here("tables", "GSE124689_metadata_fluad_clean.rds"))

#Bind mouse metadata to human data
human_mouse_fluad_metadata = GSE120661_samples_pbmc %>% 
  filter(treatment == "Fluad") %>% 
  select(sample_id = geo_sample, 
         participant_id = subject_id, 
         vaccine = treatment,
         sex,
         strain,
         sample_type = tissue,
         timepoint,
         condition) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Mouse",
         type = "Inactivated",
         adjuvant = "MF59",
         age = 7, #6–8 weeks
         timepoint = as.character(timepoint) %>% as.numeric(.) / 24,
         timepoint = if_else(timepoint < 1 & timepoint != 0,
                             as.character(round(timepoint, 1)),
                             as.character(as.integer(round(timepoint, 0)))),
         race = strain, 
         array = "Agilent-028005 SurePrint G3 Mouse GE 8x60K Microarray") %>% 
  
  #Bind human data
  bind_rows(GSE124689_metadata_clean %>% 
               select(sample_id,
                      participant_id,
                      condition, timepoint,
                      sex, age, race, vaccine, 
                      sample_type, array, 
                      type, adjuvant) %>% 
              mutate(organism = "Human",
                     vaccine = "Fluad",
                     timepoint = as.character(timepoint)))
```

Sanity check

```{r}
# Calculate quantiles for each sample and measure
quantile_summary <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>%
  group_by(sample_id, measure) %>%
  summarize(
    q0   = quantile(value, probs = 0.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25  = quantile(value, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50  = quantile(value, probs = 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75  = quantile(value, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    q100 = quantile(value, probs = 1.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("q"), names_to = "quantile", values_to = "value")

# Plot the quantiles
ggplot(quantile_summary, aes(x = quantile %>% fct_relevel("q0", "q25", "q50", "q75","q100"), 
                             y = value, 
                             group = measure, 
                             color = measure)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, position = position_dodge2(width = 0.2)) +
  labs(title = "Per-sample quantile distribution: raw vs. quantile-normalized",
       x = "Quantiles") +
  theme_vaxgo()

human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>%
  group_by(measure, organism, timepoint) %>%
  summarize(
    q0   = quantile(value, 0.00, na.rm = TRUE),

    q50  = quantile(value, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
```

##### From Log2FC
```{r}
# Calculate log2FC 
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc <- human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn %>%
  filter(measure %in% c("value_qn", "value_raw"),
         timepoint %in% c(0, 1, 3, 7)) %>%
  select(participant_id, symbol, timepoint, value, measure, organism) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value, names_prefix = "day_") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("day_"),
               names_to = "timepoint",
               names_prefix = "day_",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(participant_id, symbol, measure) %>% 
  mutate(day0 = value[timepoint == "0"]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(log2fc = value - day0) %>%
  filter(timepoint != "0")

#Average L2FC
human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg = human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc %>% 
  group_by(symbol, organism, timepoint, measure) %>% 
  summarize(avg_log2fc = mean(log2fc, na.rm = T),
            n_subjects = n(),
            #Dispersion
            sd = sd(value, na.rm = T),
            se = sd/sqrt(n_subjects),
            #Effect size
            effect_size = avg_log2fc/sd,
            #Get pval from simple t-test
            pval = tryCatch(t.test(log2fc, mu = 0)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_), 
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(ci_low = avg_log2fc - 1.96*se,
         ci_high = avg_log2fc + 1.96*se,
         pval_adj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH"))
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=16}
volcano_plot_raw_qn = volcano_data %>%

  facet_nested(~paste("Day", timepoint)+organism + measure, scales = "free_y",  space = "free_y", nest_line = element_line(linetype = 1, color = "black")) +
```

#### DGE (Mouse normalized with human)
```{r}
#DGE (Mouse normalized with human) ----
human_mouse_fluad_matrix_mouse = human_mouse_fluad_matrix %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  select(c(human_mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
           filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% 
             pull(sample_id))) %>% 
  as.matrix()

eset_mouse <- ExpressionSet(
  assayData = human_mouse_fluad_matrix_mouse,
  phenoData = AnnotatedDataFrame(human_mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
                                   column_to_rownames("sample_id") %>% 
                                   filter(organism == "Mouse"))
)

eset_mouse %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "GSE120661_eset_mouse_quantile.rds"))

design <- model.matrix(~ condition + 0, eset_mouse) # 0 defines the way we compare the samples
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  # Avoids blank spaces

# Then we estimate the correlation between measurements made on the same subject:
corfit <- duplicateCorrelation(eset_mouse, 
                               design = design, 
                               block = eset_mouse$participant_id)
corfit$consensus #0.022 (low intra-subject correlation)
# Then this inter-subject correlation is input into the linear model fit:
#Fit Limma model
fit <- lmFit(eset_mouse, design, 
             block = eset_mouse$participant_id, 
             correlation = corfit$consensus)
colnames(design) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  arrange(.)

#Test for Fluad
cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(conditionFluad_4_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             conditionFluad_8_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             conditionFluad_24_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             conditionFluad_48_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             conditionFluad_72_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             conditionFluad_168_PBMC - conditionFluad_0_PBMC,
                             levels=design)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, cont.matrix)
fit2 <- treat(fit2, lfc = 0.0)

#Get DEGs

## For every contrast
results_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2), function(i) {
  topTreat(fit2, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(comparison = colnames(fit2)[i]) %>% 
    rownames_to_column("symbol")
  })

# Combine all results
all_contrasts_degs <- bind_rows(results_list)

# Get all DEGs
all_degs_mouse = all_contrasts_degs %>% 
  select(comparison, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = str_replace(comparison, "\\.\\.\\.", "_") %>% 
           str_replace(., "timepoint", "Time") %>% 
           str_replace(., "treatment", "")) %>% 
  separate(comparison, sep = " - ", into = c("comparisonA", "comparisonRef")) %>% 
  mutate(comparisonRef = str_replace(comparisonRef, "treatment", "Time0")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(comparisonA == "conditionFluad_4_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_4_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionFluad_8_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_8_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionFluad_24_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_24_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionFluad_48_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_48_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionFluad_72_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_72_PBMC",
                               comparisonA == "conditionFluad_168_PBMC"	~ "Fluad_168_PBMC",
                               T~comparisonA)) %>% 
  select(condition, everything())
	
#Save
all_degs_mouse %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "GSE120661_degs_mouse.rds"))
```

### Loop for every time point
Obs.: Make sure that datasets from FIT package were retrieved
Initial number of genes: 15503
Number of genes for which FIT predictions will be calculated: 14401
```{r}
### Loop for every time point -----
all_degs_fit2 = all_degs_mouse %>% 
  select(symbol, EffectSize = logFC, condition) %>%
  inner_join(GSE120661_counts_not_normalized_log2_annotations %>% 
               select(symbol = mgi_symbol, MM.Entrez = entrezgene_id) %>% 
               mutate(symbol = str_to_upper(symbol)),
             by = "symbol") %>% 
  select(-symbol) %>% 
  mutate(row = MM.Entrez)

# Generate csv for every condition
all_conditions <- unique(all_degs_fit2$condition)
purrr::walk(all_conditions, function(cond) {
  
  delete_dupes <- all_degs_fit2 %>%
    filter(condition == cond) %>%
    get_dupes(row) %>%
    pull(row)
  
  filtered_df <- all_degs_fit2 %>%
    filter(condition == cond, !row %in% delete_dupes) %>%
    select(-condition) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("row") %>% 
    select(MM.Entrez, EffectSize)
  
  file_name <- paste0(cond, "_FIT_mouse.csv")
  file_path <- here("tables", file_name)
  
  write_csv(filtered_df, file_path)
})

# FIT loop
fit_results_combined <- map2_dfr(all_conditions, all_conditions, function(cond, cond_name) {
  
  file_path <- here("tables", paste0(cond, "_FIT_mouse.csv"))
  
  fit_output <- FIT.mouse2man::FIT(MouseFile = file_path, DataType = "rnaseq")

  fit_output_tbl <- as_tibble(fit_output) %>%
    mutate(condition = cond_name)
  
  return(fit_output_tbl)
})

#Print
fit_results_combined

#Save
fit_results_combined %>% saveRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "FIT_FLUAD_alltimes.csv"))
```

### Integrate Mouse, FIT, and Human data
```{r}
#Import datasets
fit_example_results_ready = readRDS(file = here("tables", "fit_example_results_ready.rds"))
fluad_human_degs = read_rds(here("tables", "GSE124689_degs.rds"))
all_degs_mouse = read_rds(file = here("tables", "GSE120661_degs_mouse.rds"))
GSE120661_metadata = read_csv(here("tables", "GSE120661_metadata.csv")) 

#Clean tables
human_mouse_fluad_metadata_datasets = human_mouse_fluad_metadata %>% 
  select(vaccine, sample_type, timepoint, condition, organism, type, array) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint))


# Annotate genes by entrez_id ------
#Get gene annotation
genes_ann = fit_example_results_ready %>% 
  select(mouse_entrez, human_entrez,human_symbol) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(human_entrez = as.character(human_entrez))

#Human
fluad_human = fluad_human_degs %>% 
  select(condition,
         symbol, 
         log2fc = mean,
         ci_low = lower,
         ci_high = upper,
         p_value,
         adj_p_val,
         organism,
         human_entrez = entrez_id
         ) %>% 
  mutate(ci_size = ci_high - ci_low,
         organism = "Human") %>% 
  inner_join(genes_ann, by = "human_entrez") %>% 
  select(-human_symbol)

#Mouse
fluad_mouse = all_degs_mouse %>%
  select(condition,
         symbol, 
         log2fc = logFC,
         ci_low = CI.L,
         ci_high = CI.R,
         p_value = P.Value,
         adj_p_val = adj.P.Val,
         ) %>% 
  mutate(ci_size = ci_high - ci_low,
         organism = "Mouse")

#FIT
fluad_fit = fit_example_results_ready %>% 
  filter(measure == "fit_prediction") %>% 
  select(condition, 
         mouse_entrez, 
         human_entrez,
         mouse_symbol,
         symbol = human_symbol, 
         log2fc = value,
         ci_low,
         ci_high,
         ) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "FIT",
         ci_size = ci_high - ci_low) %>% 
  #Get only the human entrez id used
  filter(human_entrez %in% c(fluad_human$human_entrez)) %>% 
  select(!c(mouse_entrez, human_entrez, mouse_symbol)) %>% 
  #Calculate pvalues
   mutate(
    # Estimate SE from CIs
    se = (ci_high - ci_low) / (2 * 1.96),
    z = log2fc / se,
    p_value = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z)),
    adj_p_val = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>% 
  select(!c(se, z))

#Combine tables
fit_fluad_mouse_human = fluad_human %>% 
  bind_rows(fluad_mouse, 
            fluad_fit) %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata_datasets %>% 
               select(condition, vaccine, timepoint, type),
             by = "condition") %>% 
  arrange(symbol) %>% 
  filter(timepoint %in% c(1, 3, 7)) %>% 
  select(!c(human_entrez, mouse_entrez))

#Save
fit_fluad_mouse_human %>% 
  saveRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "fit_fluad_mouse_human.rds"))

#Print
fit_fluad_mouse_human

```


6373 human genes were analyzed

Filtered:
- 5563 genes with padj > 0.10
- 3673 genes with padj > 0.50
- 1001 genes with padj > 0.90

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
#Make the table wider manually -----

#FIT
meta_fit = fit_fluad_mouse_human %>% 
  filter(organism == "FIT") %>% 
  select(symbol, 
         timepoint, 
         mean_fit = log2fc, 
         ci_low_fit = ci_low,
         ci_high_fit = ci_high,
         ci_width_fit = ci_size,
         pval_adj_fit = adj_p_val,
         pval_fit = p_value
         )

#Mouse
meta_mouse = fit_fluad_mouse_human %>% 
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>% 
  select(symbol, 
         timepoint, 
         mean_mouse = log2fc, 
         ci_low_mouse = ci_low,
         ci_high_mouse = ci_high,
         ci_width_mouse = ci_size,
         pval_adj_mouse = adj_p_val,
         pval_mouse = p_value
         ) %>% 
  #Filter out repeated values
  arrange(symbol, timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(mean_mouse_round =  mean_mouse %>% round(3),
           value = (ci_high_mouse + ci_low_mouse) / 2,
         value = value %>% round(3)) %>% 
  mutate(test = if_else(value == mean_mouse_round, "T", "no")) %>% 
  filter(test == "T") %>% 
  select(-c(test, value, mean_mouse_round))

#Human
meta_human = fit_fluad_mouse_human %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  select(symbol, 
         timepoint, 
         mean_human = log2fc, 
         ci_low_human = ci_low,
         ci_high_human = ci_high,
         ci_width_human = ci_size,
         pval_adj_human = adj_p_val,
         pval_human = p_value)

#Unite and calculate summary statistics
pairwise_human_fit_measures = meta_human %>% 
  inner_join(meta_fit, by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  inner_join(meta_mouse, by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(human_2_mouse = mean_human - mean_mouse,
         human_2_fit = mean_human - mean_fit) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  
    mutate(
    # Estimate SE from CIs
    se_human = (ci_high_human - ci_low_human) / (2 * 1.96),
    se_fit = (ci_high_fit - ci_low_fit) / (2 * 1.96),
    se_mouse = (ci_high_mouse - ci_low_mouse) / (2 * 1.96),
    
    # Combine SE
    se_diff_h2fit = sqrt(se_human^2 + se_fit^2),
    se_diff_h2m = sqrt(se_human^2 + se_mouse^2),
    
    # Z score
    z_score_h2fit = human_2_fit / se_diff_h2fit,
    z_score_h2m = human_2_mouse / se_diff_h2m,
    
    # p-value
    p_value_h2fit = 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_score_h2fit))),
    p_value_h2m = 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_score_h2m))),
    
    # FDR (Benjamini-Hochberg)
    p_value_h2fit_adj = p.adjust(p_value_h2fit, method = "BH"),
    p_value_h2m_adj = p.adjust(p_value_h2m, method = "BH"),
    
    # Cohen's d
    effect_size_h2fit = human_2_fit / se_diff_h2fit,
    effect_size_h2m = human_2_mouse / se_diff_h2m)  %>% 
  
  
  #Reorder cols
  select(
    timepoint, symbol,
    #Human
    mean_human,
    ci_low_human, ci_high_human, ci_width_human,
    se_human, pval_human, pval_adj_human,
    #FIT
    mean_fit,
    ci_low_fit, ci_high_fit, ci_width_fit,
    se_fit, pval_fit, pval_adj_fit,
    #Mouse
    mean_mouse,
    ci_low_mouse, ci_high_mouse, ci_width_mouse,
    se_mouse, pval_mouse, pval_adj_mouse,
    #Comparison
    human_2_mouse,
    human_2_fit,
    se_diff_h2fit, se_diff_h2m,
    z_score_h2fit, z_score_h2m,
    p_value_h2fit, p_value_h2fit_adj,
    p_value_h2m, p_value_h2m_adj,
    effect_size_h2fit, effect_size_h2m
  )

#Save wide dataset
pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  saveRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "pairwise_human_fit_measures.rds"))

#Save long dataset
fit_fluad_mouse_human %>% 
  mutate(condition =  paste(organism, "Day", timepoint)) %>%
```

Import
```{r}
# Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) --------

#Import datasets ------
pairwise_human_fit_measures = read_rds(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "pairwise_human_fit_measures.rds"))
ImmuneGO_Mouse_Manual <- read_excel(here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_Mouse.xlsx"))

  separate_rows(genes)

ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes = read_csv(file = here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes.csv"))
dge_long_genes = read_rds(file= here("tables", "dge_fit_mouse_human_long.rds"))

#Clean table
annotation_conditions = dge_long_genes %>% 
  select(condition, timepoint, model = organism) %>% 
  distinct()

#Run GSEA -----
#Human ImmuneGO

#Clean table for GSEA standard
term2gene = ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes %>% 
  select(process, genes)
df_genes2GSEA_human = dge_long_genes %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  select(condition, genes = symbol, log2fold_change = log2fc) 

#Run multiple GSEA
gsea_results_immuneGO_Manual_human = autoGSEA(df = df_genes2GSEA_human,
         TERM2GENE = term2gene,
         geneset_name = "Human_ImmuneGO")
  
#Save

    saveRDS(here("GSEA_ORA", "gsea_results_immuneGO_BTM_Human_Manual.rds"))
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  fill(p_adjust_Human, .direction = "up") %>%
```

### Get by zscore

Get highly correlated genes and discretize by quantile

#### Mouse
```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#Get highly correlated genes and discretize by quantile -----
#By zscores ------
#Mouse
zscore_genes_mouse = pairwise_human_fit_test %>% 
  select(human_symbol,timepoint,  mean_human, mean_mouse, pval_adj_mouse, pval_adj_human, z_score_h2m) %>% 
  arrange(z_score_h2m, human_symbol) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
                    arrange(abs(z_score_h2m)) %>% 
  mutate(diff = mean_human - mean_mouse,
         diff = round(diff, 3),
         mean_human = round(mean_human, 3),
         mean_mouse = round(mean_mouse, 3),
         comparison = "Human vs Mouse") %>% 
  rename(zscore = z_score_h2m,
         mean_model = mean_mouse,
         pval_model_adj = pval_adj_mouse) %>% 
  
  #Discretize by quantile (zscore)
  mutate(
    quartile_label = cut(abs(zscore),
                         breaks = quantile(abs(zscore),
                                           probs = c(0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                                           na.rm = TRUE),
                         include.lowest = TRUE,
                         labels = c("Q10", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")),
    timepoint_day = paste0("Day ", timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(pval_model_adj = if_else(pval_model_adj <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG"),
         pval_human_adj = if_else(pval_adj_human <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG")) 

#Pivot and sum only DEGs
zscore_genes_mouse %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(human_symbol, timepoint, pval_model_adj, pval_human_adj) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pval_model_adj, pval_human_adj),
               names_to =  "model",
               values_to = "deg") %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, model, deg) %>% 
  summarize(n = n()) %>% 
  filter(deg =="DEG")
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
zscore_genes_fit = pairwise_human_fit_test %>% 
  select(human_symbol,timepoint,  mean_human, mean_fit, pval_adj_fit, pval_adj_human, z_score_h2fit) %>% 
  arrange(z_score_h2fit, human_symbol) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>%
  arrange(abs(z_score_h2fit)) %>% 
  mutate(diff = mean_human - mean_fit,
         diff = round(diff, 3),
         mean_human = round(mean_human, 3),
         mean_fit = round(mean_fit, 3),
         comparison = "Human vs FIT") %>% 
  rename(zscore = z_score_h2fit,
         mean_model = mean_fit,
         pval_model_adj = pval_adj_fit) %>%
  
  #Discretize by quantile (zscore)
  mutate(quartile_label = cut(abs(zscore),
                         breaks = quantile(abs(zscore),
                                           probs = c(0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                                           na.rm = TRUE),
                         include.lowest = TRUE,
                         labels = c("Q10", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")),
    timepoint_day = paste0("Day ", timepoint)) %>% 
    mutate(pval_model_adj = if_else(pval_model_adj <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG"),
         pval_human_adj = if_else(pval_adj_human <= 0.05, "DEG", "Not DEG")) 

#Bind tables
zscore_genes = bind_rows(zscore_genes_fit, zscore_genes_mouse)

#Print
zscore_genes
```

```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
#Get all genes by quantile
quantiles <- zscore_genes %>%
  group_by(comparison) %>%
  summarise(
    q10  = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25  = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50  = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75  = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    q100 = quantile(abs(zscore), probs = 1.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Cumulative quantiles
diff_correlation_plot_data <- zscore_genes %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(quantiles, by = "comparison") %>%
  mutate(
    Q10  = abs(zscore) <= q10,
    Q25  = abs(zscore) <= q25,
    Q50  = abs(zscore) <= q50,
    Q75  = abs(zscore) <= q75,
    Q100 = abs(zscore) <= q100
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Q10, Q25, Q50, Q75, Q100),
    names_to = "quantile_label_grouped",
    values_to = "in_quantile"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    quantile_label_grouped = fct_relevel(quantile_label_grouped, "Q10", "Q25", "Q50", "Q75", "Q100")
  ) %>%
  filter(in_quantile) %>%
  select(-in_quantile)
```

### Enrichment analysis of genes in best and worst quartiles

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height= 8}
# Enrichment analysis -------
organism = "org.Hs.eg.db"
#Hallmarks
#Retrieve human H (hallmark) gene set
msigdbr_raw <- msigdbr(species = "human", category = "H") 
#Clean
msigdbr_df = msigdbr_raw %>% 
  select(process = gs_name, genes = gene_symbol) %>% 
  mutate(process = str_remove(process, "HALLMARK_"))

#Discretize by quartile
df_genes_best_worst_fit_mouse = zscore_genes %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(quartiles_grouped = case_when(
    quartile_label %in% c("Q10", "Q25") ~ "<Q25",
    quartile_label %in% c("Q75", "Q100") ~ ">Q75",
    TRUE ~ quartile_label)) %>% 
    mutate(condition = paste0(comparison, "", quartiles_grouped, " (", timepoint_day,")")) %>% 
  filter(quartiles_grouped != "Q50") %>% 
  select(genes = human_symbol,
         condition)

#Run ORA Hallmarks
ora_all_diff_hallmark <- enricher_condition(
  df = df_genes_best_worst_fit_mouse,
  term2gene_df = msigdbr_df) %>% 
  mutate(log_p_adjust = -log(p_adjust)) %>% 
  mutate(description = str_replace_all(description, "_", " ")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_extract(condition, "(?<=\\(Day )\\d+")) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = case_when(str_detect(condition, "FIT") ~ "FIT",
                                str_detect(condition, "Mouse") ~ "Mouse"))

#Save
ora_all_diff_hallmark %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("GSEA_ORA", "ora_all_diff_hallmark.rds"))

#Print
ora_all_diff_hallmark
```

##### Plot ORA Hallmark
```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
##### Plot ORA Hallmark ------
#Import
ora_all_diff_hallmark = readRDS(file = here("GSEA_ORA", "ora_all_diff_hallmark.rds"))
#Cluster rows
row_clustered = ora_all_diff_hallmark %>% 
    dplyr::select(condition, description, log_p_adjust) %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
                values_from= "log_p_adjust") %>%
    column_to_rownames("description") %>% 
    as.matrix() %>% 
    replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% 
    dist(.) %>% 
    hclust()

#Plot
ora_all_diff_hallmark_heatmap = ora_all_diff_hallmark %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  filter(description %in% c(row_clustered$labels)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(condition, description, log_p_adjust, p_adjust, everything()) %>% 
    mutate(signific = case_when(p_adjust <= 0.10 ~ "*",
                              p_adjust <= 0.25 ~ "-",
                              p_adjust <= 0.50 ~ "/",
                              p_adjust <= 0.05 ~ "**",
                              TRUE ~ ""),
           quantile = str_extract(condition, "Q\\d{2,3}"),
        condition = paste(quantile)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=condition, y = str_to_upper(description), fill = log_p_adjust)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black", 
            size = 0.2, na.rm = F, stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = signific), size = 4, vjust = 0.5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "white",     
        high = "#4DBBD5FF",   
        n.breaks = 3,
        oob = scales::squish,
        limits = c(0, 4),      # fixa o intervalo
        name = "-Log(FDR)") +
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 8) ,
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.key.width = unit(0.2, 'cm'),
          legend.key.height = unit(0.4, 'cm'),
          axis.line.y  = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 1, hjust=0.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "black"),
          strip.text.x = element_text(color = "white"),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(0, 0.5, 0, 1, unit = "cm"),
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.position = "top") +
    scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
     labs(x = "",
         y = "",
         title = "ORA, MSigDB Hallmarks") +
  facet_nested(~ paste("Day", timepoint) + fct_rev(comparison), scales = "free", space = "free")
```

## Top best and worst predicted genes in FIT and Mouse

```{r}

# Top best and worst predicted genes in FIT and Mouse -----
pairwise_human_fit_genes_long =  pairwise_human_fit_measures %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mean_human, mean_mouse, mean_fit),
               values_to = "l2fc",
               names_to = "organism") %>% 
  rename(diff_h2m = human_2_mouse,
         diff_h2fit = human_2_fit) %>% 
  mutate(organism = if_else(organism == "FIT Prediction", "FIT", organism)) %>% 
  
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(symbol, timepoint, organism),
               values_to = "value",
               names_to = "metric") %>% 
  mutate(
    organism = case_when(
      str_detect(metric, "human") ~ "Human",
      str_detect(metric, "fit") ~ "FIT",
      str_detect(metric, "mouse") ~ "Mouse",
      metric == "Human" ~ "Human",
      metric == "FIT Prediction" ~ "FIT",
      TRUE ~ organism),
    metric = str_remove_all(metric, "_?(human|mouse|fit)$"),
    metric = str_remove_all(metric, "_?(human|mouse|fit)")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(organism = case_when(str_detect(metric, "h2m") ~ "Mouse",
                              str_detect(metric, "h2") ~ "FIT",
                              T~organism))  %>% 
  mutate(organism = case_when(organism == "mean_fit" ~ "FIT",
                              organism == "mean_human" ~ "Human",
                              organism == "mean_mouse" ~ "Mouse",
                              T ~ organism))

#Comparisons
pairwise_human_fit_measures_comparisons = pairwise_human_fit_measures %>%
    select(timepoint, symbol, human_2_mouse:effect_size_h2m) 

#Pivot table and join the comparisons
pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide = pairwise_human_fit_genes_long %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "metric",
              values_from = "value", 
              values_fn = mean) %>% 
  select(!c(pval:effect_size_h2m)) %>% 
  inner_join(pairwise_human_fit_measures_comparisons,
                by = join_by("timepoint", "symbol")) 

  
 

top_genes_human = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  relocate(ci_width,  .after = organism) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(ci_width) 
  
 top_genes_mouse = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(organism == "Mouse",
         symbol %in% c(top_genes_human$symbol)) %>% 
   arrange(ci_width, desc(p_value_h2m_adj), human_2_mouse)
 
 top_genes_fit = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  filter(organism == "FIT",
         symbol %in% c(top_genes_human$symbol)) %>% 
   arrange(ci_width, desc(p_value_h2fit_adj), human_2_fit)

top_genes_mouse
top_genes_fit
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=3}
#Plot histogram of genes by cutoff
library(ggridges)
pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide_distribution_data = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>% 
  # filter(!is.na(p_value_diff_human)) %>% 
  mutate(
    # p_value_diff_human = if_else(organism == "Human", pval_adj, p_value_diff_human),
    `<0.01` = abs(pval_adj) <= 0.01,
    `<0.05` = abs(pval_adj) <= 0.05,
    `<0.10` = abs(pval_adj) <= 0.10,
    `<0.25` = abs(pval_adj) <= 0.25,
    `<1.00` = abs(pval_adj) <= 1.00
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("<"),
               names_to = "threshold_label",
               values_to = "in_threshold") %>%
  mutate(threshold_label = forcats::fct_relevel(
    threshold_label, "<0.01", "<0.05", "<0.10", "<0.25", "<1.00"
  )) %>%
  filter(in_threshold) %>%
  select(-in_threshold) 
  
options(scipen = 999)
pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide_distribution = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide_distribution_data %>% 
  filter(!organism == "Human") %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = mean) +
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(count),
                   fill = organism,
                   # fill = organism,
                   ), 
                  position = position_identity(), 
               alpha = 0.5,
                 show.legend = F) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(count),
                   color = organism,
                   # fill = organism,
                   ), 
                  position = position_identity(), alpha = 0.5,
                 show.legend = F) +
  geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(count),
                   color = organism), 
               position = position_identity(),
               data = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide_distribution_data %>% 
                    filter(organism == "Human"),
                 fill = NA,
               show.legend = T,
               alpha = 1) +
  
  facet_wrap(~threshold_label, 
             scale = "free_y",
             ncol = 1, 
             strip.position="right") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01), n.breaks = 3, 
                     # labels = scales::comma
                     ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
  values = c(
    FIT = "#4361ee", 
    Mouse = "#4DBBD5FF",
    Human = "#546E7AFF"))+
    scale_color_manual(
  values = c(
    FIT = "#4361ee", 
    Mouse = "#4DBBD5FF",
    Human = "#546E7AFF"))+
    theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
        strip.text.y = element_text(color = "black", angle = 0), 
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.8, "lines"),
        strip.background.y = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA)) +
  labs(fill = "",
       color = "",
       x = "Log2-fold change",
       y = "Total",
       title = "Frequency of genes by p value cutoff")
```

#### Get ranks
```{r}
#Get ranks -----
#Mouse
ranks_mouse = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>%
  filter(organism == "Mouse") %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint, z_score_h2m, organism) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint, abs(z_score_h2m)) %>%
  mutate(percent_rank = percent_rank(abs(z_score_h2m)),
         percentile = round(percent_rank * 100, 2)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  rename(zscore_h2model = z_score_h2m)
#FIT
ranks_fit = pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide %>%
  filter(organism == "FIT") %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint, z_score_h2fit, organism) %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint, abs(z_score_h2fit)) %>%
  mutate(percent_rank = percent_rank(abs(z_score_h2fit)),
         percentile = round(percent_rank * 100, 2)) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  rename(zscore_h2model = z_score_h2fit)

#Fit vs Mouse
ranks_fit_vs_mouse = ranks_fit %>% 
  select(symbol, fit = percentile, timepoint_ref = timepoint, zscore_h2fit = zscore_h2model) %>% 
  inner_join(ranks_mouse %>% 
               select(symbol, mouse = percentile,
                      timepoint_other = timepoint,
                      zscore_h2mouse = zscore_h2model),
             by = "symbol") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_ref = as.character(timepoint_ref),
         timepoint_other = as.character(timepoint_other),
         condition = "Top FIT vs Mouse")

#Mouse vs FIT
ranks_mouse_vs_fit = ranks_mouse %>% 
  select(symbol, mouse = percentile, timepoint_ref = timepoint, zscore_h2mouse = zscore_h2model) %>% 
  inner_join(ranks_fit %>% 
               select(symbol, fit = percentile,
                      timepoint_other = timepoint,
                      zscore_h2fit = zscore_h2model),
             by = "symbol") %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_ref = as.character(timepoint_ref),
         timepoint_other = as.character(timepoint_other),
         condition = "Top Mouse vs FIT")


#Get genes that are in the 10th percentile in one model, but are in the 90th percentile in the other
ranks_best_fit_and_mouse = ranks_fit_vs_mouse %>%
  filter(fit < 10, mouse > 90) %>%
  bind_rows(ranks_mouse_vs_fit %>%
              filter(mouse < 10, fit > 90)) %>%
  select(condition,
         symbol,
         timepoint_ref,
         timepoint_other, 
         fit, zscore_h2fit,
         mouse, zscore_h2mouse)

ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_long <- ranks_best_fit_and_mouse %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(fit, mouse),
    names_to = "model",
    values_to = "percentile"
  )


#Get genes with least zscores in one model, but have the highest zscore in the other
ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_zscore = ranks_fit_vs_mouse %>%

  # FILTER BY N
  filter(timepoint_ref == timepoint_other) %>%
  arrange(abs(zscore_h2fit), desc(abs(zscore_h2mouse))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>% 
  bind_rows(ranks_mouse_vs_fit %>%
              filter(timepoint_ref == timepoint_other) %>%
  arrange(abs(zscore_h2mouse), desc(abs(zscore_h2fit))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)) %>%
  select(condition,
         symbol,
         timepoint_ref,
         timepoint_other, 
         fit = zscore_h2fit,
         mouse = zscore_h2mouse)

ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_long_zscore <- ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_zscore %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(fit, mouse),
    names_to = "model",
    values_to = "zscore"
  )

ranks_best_fit_and_mouse_long_zscore
```

```{r}
  arrange(abs(z_score_h2m)) %>%
```

## Compute overall metrics

```{r}

pairwise_human_fit_test$human_symbol %>% unique() %>% length() #6373
```

### All genes

#### Calculate metrics
```{r}

library(yardstick)
#FIT
filter_conditions_fit <- expand_grid(
  padj_fit = c(0.01, 0.05, seq(0.1, 1, by = 0.1)),
  expr_cutoff = c(0.01, seq(0.05, 0.5, by = 0.05), 0.75, 1),
  ci_percentile = c(0.3, 1.0),
  timepoint = c(1, 3, 7)
)

filter_conditions_results_fit_degs <- filter_conditions_fit %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do({
    fc <- .
    
    # Filtrar apenas dados do timepoint atual
    data_timepoint <- pairwise_human_fit_test %>%
      filter(timepoint == fc$timepoint)

    # Calcular o cutoff do percentil escolhido
    ci_cutoff <- quantile(data_timepoint$ci_width_fit, probs = fc$ci_percentile, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Aplicar filtros
    filtered_data <- data_timepoint %>%
      filter(
        pval_adj_fit < fc$padj_fit,
        abs(mean_fit) > fc$expr_cutoff,
        ci_width_fit <= ci_cutoff
      )

    if (nrow(filtered_data) >= 2) {
      metrics <- filtered_data %>%
        summarise(
          n_genes = n(),
          RMSE = rmse_vec(mean_human, mean_fit),
          MAE = mae_vec(mean_human, mean_fit),
          R2 = rsq_vec(mean_human, mean_fit),
          Spearman = cor(mean_human, mean_fit, method = "spearman"),
          Pearson = cor(mean_human, mean_fit, method = "pearson")
        )
    } else {
      metrics <- tibble(
        n_genes = 0,
        RMSE = NA, MAE = NA, R2 = NA,
        Spearman = NA, Pearson = NA
      )
    }

    bind_cols(fc, tibble(ci_width_cutoff = ci_cutoff), metrics)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(organism = "FIT") %>%
  rename(padj_cutoff = padj_fit) %>% 
  mutate(ci_percentile = paste0(ci_percentile * 100, "%"))

filter_conditions_results_fit_degs

#Mouse
filter_conditions_mouse <- expand_grid(
  padj_mouse = c(0.01, 0.05, seq(0.1, 1, by = 0.1)),
  expr_cutoff = c(0.01, seq(0.05, 0.5, by = 0.05), 0.75, 1),
  ci_percentile = c(0.3, 1.0),
  timepoint = c(1, 3, 7)
)

filter_conditions_results_mouse_degs <- filter_conditions_mouse %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do({
    fc <- .
    
    # Filtrar apenas dados do timepoint atual
    data_timepoint <- pairwise_human_fit_test %>%
      filter(timepoint == fc$timepoint)

    # Calcular o cutoff do percentil escolhido
    ci_cutoff <- quantile(data_timepoint$ci_width_mouse, probs = fc$ci_percentile, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Aplicar filtros
    filtered_data <- data_timepoint %>%
      filter(
        pval_adj_mouse < fc$padj_mouse,
        abs(mean_mouse) > fc$expr_cutoff,
        ci_width_mouse <= ci_cutoff
      )

    if (nrow(filtered_data) >= 2) {
      metrics <- filtered_data %>%
        summarise(
          n_genes = n(),
          RMSE = rmse_vec(mean_human, mean_mouse),
          MAE = mae_vec(mean_human, mean_mouse),
          R2 = rsq_vec(mean_human, mean_mouse),
          Spearman = cor(mean_human, mean_mouse, method = "spearman"),
          Pearson = cor(mean_human, mean_mouse, method = "pearson")
        )
    } else {
      metrics <- tibble(
        n_genes = 0,
        RMSE = NA, MAE = NA, R2 = NA,
        Spearman = NA, Pearson = NA
      )
    }

    bind_cols(fc, tibble(ci_width_cutoff = ci_cutoff), metrics)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(organism = "Mouse") %>%
  rename(padj_cutoff = padj_mouse) %>% 
  mutate(ci_percentile = paste0(ci_percentile * 100, "%"))

filter_conditions_results_mouse_degs  

metrics_FIT_M_vs_FIT_filtered_DEGs = filter_conditions_results_mouse_degs %>% 
  bind_rows(filter_conditions_results_fit_degs) %>% 
  mutate(filter = if_else(organism == "FIT", paste0("FIT CI ", ci_percentile), NA),
         filter = if_else(organism == "Mouse", paste0("Mouse CI ", ci_percentile), filter)) %>% 
  select(organism,filter, everything()) %>% 
  filter(expr_cutoff <= 0.5)

metrics_FIT_M_vs_FIT_filtered_DEGs %>% 
  saveRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "metrics_FIT_M_vs_FIT_filtered_DEGs.rds"))
```

#### RMSE
```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=12}
metrics_FIT_M_vs_FIT_filtered_RMSE_plot = metrics_FIT_M_vs_FIT_filtered_DEGs %>%
  mutate(across(ci_width_cutoff:timepoint, as.character)) %>%
  mutate(filter = fct_relevel(filter, 
                              "Mouse CI 10%", 
                              "Mouse CI 30%", 
                              "Mouse CI 50%",
                              "Mouse CI 100%",
                              "FIT CI 10%",
                              "FIT CI 30%", 
                              "FIT CI 50%", 
                              "FIT CI 100%")) %>% 
  filter(filter %in% c("Mouse CI 30%",
                        "Mouse CI 100%",
                        "FIT CI 30%",
                        "FIT CI 100%")) %>% 
  filter(padj_cutoff <= 0.25) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = expr_cutoff, y = RMSE)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = filter,
                color = filter)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = filter,
                 # size = n_genes
                 ),
             alpha = 0.8,
             pch = 21,
             # fill = NA,
             width = 0.1,
             # size = 0.5
             ) +
  ggh4x::facet_grid2(
    rows = vars(timepoint),
    cols = vars(padj_cutoff),
    switch = "both",
    labeller = labeller(
      timepoint = as_labeller(c("1" = "Day 1", 
                                "3" = "Day 3", 
                                "7" = "Day 7")),
      padj_cutoff = function(x) paste("padj:", x)  
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 4) +
  scale_size(range = c(0.1, 3), breaks = c(10, 100, 500, 1000)) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.key = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 0),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "lines")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "RMSE",
    x = "L2FC Cutoff",
    y = "RMSE",
    color = "",
    size = "Number of genes"
  ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse CI 30%" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Mouse CI 100%" = "#80a1d4",
    "FIT CI 30%"   = "#4361ee",
    "FIT CI 100%"   = "#dec0f1"
  )) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse CI 30%" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Mouse CI 100%" = "#80a1d4",
    "FIT CI 30%"   = "#4361ee",
    "FIT CI 100%"   = "#dec0f1"
  ))
```

#### Plot correlation

Mouse vs Human (cutoffs for mouse)

```{r}
corr_plots_data = pairwise_human_fit_test %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint, mean_mouse, mean_human, mean_fit,
         pval_adj_human, pval_adj_mouse, pval_adj_fit) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pval_adj_human, pval_adj_mouse, pval_adj_fit),
               names_to = "measure",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    pval_cuts = case_when(
      value <= 0.01 ~ "0.01",
      value <= 0.05 ~ "0.05",
      TRUE ~ "1"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = measure,
    values_from = pval_cuts,
    values_fn = list
  ) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(pval_adj_human, pval_adj_mouse, pval_adj_fit)) %>% 
  fill(pval_adj_human, .direction = "down") %>% 
  fill(pval_adj_mouse, .direction = "up") %>% 
  fill(pval_adj_fit, .direction = "up") %>% 
  mutate(pval_cuts_mouse_human = if_else(pval_adj_human == pval_adj_mouse, pval_adj_human, "Not equal"),
         pval_cuts_fit_human = if_else(pval_adj_human == pval_adj_fit, pval_adj_fit, "Not equal"),
         pval_cuts_mouse_fit = if_else(pval_adj_fit == pval_adj_mouse, pval_adj_fit, "Not equal"))
```

```{r}
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = l2fc, fill = organism) +

  facet_grid(~organism)
```

### Classify by grid of cutoffs
```{r}
# Define cutoffs
padj_cutoffs <- c(0.05)
l2fc_cutoffs <- c(0, 0.5)
ci_percentiles <- c(0.3, 1.0)

# Expand grid
cutoff_grid <- expand_grid(
  padj_cutoff = padj_cutoffs,
  l2fc_cutoff = l2fc_cutoffs,
  ci_percentile = ci_percentiles
)

# Classify by every combination
base_df <- pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide

classified_df <- pmap_dfr(
  cutoff_grid,
  function(padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff, ci_percentile) {
    
    ci_cutoff <- quantile(base_df$ci_width, probs = ci_percentile, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    base_df %>%
      filter(ci_width <= ci_cutoff) %>%
      mutate(
        padj_cutoff = padj_cutoff,
        l2fc_cutoff = l2fc_cutoff,
        ci_percentile = ci_percentile,
        classification = case_when(
          pval_adj < padj_cutoff & l2fc >= l2fc_cutoff  ~ "up",
          pval_adj < padj_cutoff & l2fc < -l2fc_cutoff ~ "down",
          TRUE                                          ~ "neutral"
    ))})


classified_df %>% 
  saveRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "genes_l2fc_fit_mouse_human_classified_cutoffs.rds"))
```

```{r}
classified_wide <- classified_df %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff, organism, classification) %>%
  filter(l2fc_cutoff == 0) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "organism", values_from = "classification") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Human) & !is.na(FIT) & !is.na(Mouse)) %>% 
  mutate(
    fit_correct = FIT == Human,
    mouse_correct = Mouse == Human
  )
classified_wide %>% 
  glimpse()
classified_eval = classified_wide

my_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, precision, recall, f_meas, spec, sens)

### FIT
# "up" vs all
acc_up_vs_all_fit <- classified_eval %>%
  mutate(
    truth = factor(ifelse(Human == "up", "up", "not_up"), levels = c("up", "not_up")),
    estimate = factor(ifelse(FIT == "up", "up", "not_up"), levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff) %>%
  my_metrics(truth = truth, estimate = estimate) %>%
  mutate(model = "FIT", target = "up")
# "down" vs all
acc_down_vs_all_fit <- classified_eval %>%
  mutate(
    truth = factor(ifelse(Human == "down", "down", "not_down"), levels = c("down", "not_down")),
    estimate = factor(ifelse(FIT == "down", "down", "not_down"), levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff) %>%
  my_metrics(truth = truth, estimate = estimate) %>%
  mutate(model = "FIT", target = "down")

acc_fit_results <- bind_rows(acc_up_vs_all_fit, acc_down_vs_all_fit)

fit_classification_degs_ngenes <- classified_eval %>%
  mutate(
    truth = factor(Human, levels = c("up", "down", "neutral")),
    estimate = factor(FIT, levels = c("up", "down", "neutral")),
    correct = truth == estimate,
    incorrect = truth != estimate
  ) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff, truth) %>%
  summarise(
    num_correct_tp = sum(correct, na.rm = T),
    num_incorrect_fp = sum(incorrect, na.rm = T),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(model = "FIT")


fit_classification_degs_ngenes = bind_rows(fit_classification_degs_ngenes)

fit_classification_degs = acc_fit_results %>% 
  rename(truth = target) %>% 
  inner_join(fit_classification_degs_ngenes,
             by = join_by("model", "timepoint", "padj_cutoff", "l2fc_cutoff", "truth"))

fit_classification_degs %>% 
  arrange(-.estimate) %>% 
  filter(num_correct_tp > 0)
```

#### ROC Curve
Do for one direction (up and then down)
Do one sided t test limma for mouse, fit, and human
Positive control: Human
Neg control: Random permutation
```{r}
library(pracma)
#Import DEGs table
dge_long_genes = read_rds(file= here("tables", "dge_fit_mouse_human_long.rds"))
#ImmuneGO ontologies
ImmuneGO_Mouse_Manual_genes <- read_excel(here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_Mouse.xlsx")) %>% 
 separate_rows(genes)
immunego_btm_manual_grouped = read_csv(file = here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genesets.csv"))
ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes = read_csv(file = here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes.csv"))

######### UP -----------
#Do one sided t-test for each model
dge_long_genes_up = dge_long_genes %>% 
  filter(symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes %>% unique())) %>%
  mutate(
    se = (ci_high - ci_low) / (2 * 1.96),
    z = log2fc / se,
    pval_one_sided = pnorm(z, lower.tail = F), #onesided, p(gene) > 0 (right tail)
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj < 0.05, "up", "not_up")) %>%
  select(-adj_p_val) %>% 
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

#Assign human log2fc direction as truth
truth_human = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  select(symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "organism",
              values_from = "direction") %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

#Generate comparable distributions
perfect_prediction = truth_human %>%
  mutate(prob = adj_p_val) %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

permutation_prediction = perfect_prediction %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = randperm(prob),
         organism = "Permutation")

uniform_prediction = perfect_prediction %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()),
         organism = "Uniform")

shuffle_prediction = perfect_prediction %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = sample(prob),
         organism = "Shuffle")

normal_prediction = perfect_prediction %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = rnorm(n(), mean = 0.5, sd = 0.1),
         prob= pmin(pmax(prob, 0), 1),
         organism = "Normal")

#Get only up and not up genes from models
models_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  filter(symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes %>% unique())) %>%
  mutate(
    se = (ci_high - ci_low) / (2 * 1.96),
    z = log2fc / se,
    pval_one_sided = pnorm(z, lower.tail = F), #one sided, higher
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj < 0.05, "up", "not_up")) %>%
  select(-adj_p_val) %>% 
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj) %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         prob = adj_p_val) %>% 
  #Add controls
  bind_rows(
    perfect_prediction,
    permutation_prediction,
    uniform_prediction,
    shuffle_prediction,
    normal_prediction
    )

#Get probabilities (UP)
classified_df_probs_up = truth_human %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_up %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model = organism),
             by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(not_prob = 1 - prob,
         sum = prob + not_prob,
         truth = as.factor(truth)) %>% 
  distinct()


#Get ROC
roc_curve_up_notup = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Human", "Mouse", "Uniform", "FIT")) %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth, pred, model, prob, not_prob, sum) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up vs Non-Up")


######### DOWN -----------
#Do one sided t-test for each model
dge_long_genes_down = dge_long_genes %>% 
  filter(symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes %>% unique())) %>%
  mutate(
    se = (ci_high - ci_low) / (2 * 1.96),
    z = log2fc / se,
    pval_one_sided = pnorm(z, lower.tail = T), #onesided, p(gene) < 0 (left tail)
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj < 0.05, "down", "not_down")) %>%
  select(-adj_p_val) %>% 
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

#Assign human log2fc direction as truth
truth_human = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  select(symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "organism",
              values_from = "direction") %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

#Generate comparable distributions
perfect_prediction = truth_human %>%
  mutate(prob = adj_p_val) %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

permutation_prediction = perfect_prediction %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = randperm(prob),
         organism = "Permutation")

uniform_prediction = perfect_prediction %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()),
         organism = "Uniform")

shuffle_prediction = perfect_prediction %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = sample(prob),
         organism = "Shuffle")

normal_prediction = perfect_prediction %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = rnorm(n(), mean = 0.5, sd = 0.1),
         prob= pmin(pmax(prob, 0), 1),
         organism = "Normal")

#Get only up and not up genes from models
models_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  filter(symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes %>% unique())) %>%
  mutate(
    se = (ci_high - ci_low) / (2 * 1.96),
    z = log2fc / se,
    pval_one_sided = pnorm(z, lower.tail = T), #one sided, less
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj < 0.05, "down", "not_down")) %>%
  select(-adj_p_val) %>% 
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj) %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         prob = adj_p_val) %>% 
  #Add controls
  bind_rows(
    perfect_prediction,
    permutation_prediction,
    uniform_prediction,
    shuffle_prediction,
    normal_prediction
    )

#Get probabilities (DOWN)
classified_df_probs_down = truth_human %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_down %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model = organism),
             by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(not_prob = 1 - prob,
         sum = prob + not_prob,
         truth = as.factor(truth)) %>% 
  distinct()


#Get ROC
roc_curve_down_notdown = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Human", "Mouse", "Uniform", "FIT")) %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth, pred, model, prob, not_prob, sum) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down vs Non-Down")
```

#### Confusion matrix
```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(purrr) # Make sure this line is run before using reduce

##### Function
#Get summaries
get_confmat_summary <- function(data, model_selected, timepoint_selected) {
  data %>%
    filter(model == model_selected, timepoint == timepoint_selected) %>%
    conf_mat(truth, predicted) %>% # Assumes 'truth' and 'predicted' columns exist
    summary() %>% 
    mutate(model = model_selected,
           timepoint = timepoint_selected)
}


# Plot heatmap for every combination
plot_xconfmat_heatmap <- function(data, 
                                 model_selected, 
                                 timepoint_selected) {
  
  data %>%
    filter(model == model_selected, timepoint == timepoint_selected) %>%
    conf_mat(truth, predicted) %>%
    autoplot(type = "heatmap") +
    aes(
      fill = Freq,
      x = fct_rev(str_to_upper(Prediction)),
      y = str_to_upper(Truth),
      label = Freq
    ) +
    geom_tile(color = "black") +
    geom_text() +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top", expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      x = "Predicted",
      y = "Truth",
      title = paste(model_selected, "Day", timepoint_selected)
    ) +
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.line.x = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "white",
      high = "#80a1d4",
      n.breaks = 3
    )
}
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
  labs(title = "Which genes vary only in mouse?",
       subtitle = "Top 10 genes with highest covariance. Mean cutoff > 0.1") 


genes_vary_mouse_human = cov_genes_FIT_training %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = mean_human_time,
      y = mean_mouse_time) +
  geom_point(color = "black", fill = NA, pch = 21) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1.5, 1.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1.5, 1.5)) +
  gghighlight(abs(mean_human_time) >= 0.1,
                abs(mean_mouse_time) >= 0.1,
                            unhighlighted_params = list(alpha = 0.2, fill = NA)) +
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = human_symbol), max.overlaps = 20, force_pull = 4, size = 3,
                  data = cov_genes_FIT_training %>% 
                    filter(abs(mean_human_time) >= 0.1,
                abs(mean_mouse_time) >= 0.1) %>% 
                  arrange(-abs(cov)) %>% 
                  slice_head(n = 10)) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(title = "Which genes vary in both human and mouse?",
       subtitle = "Top 10 genes with highest covariance. Mean cutoff > 0.1")

genes_notvary_mouse_human = cov_genes_FIT_training %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = mean_human_time,
      y = mean_mouse_time) +
  geom_point(color = "black", fill = NA, pch = 21) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1.5, 1.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1.5, 1.5)) +
  gghighlight(abs(mean_human_time) <= 0.1,
                abs(mean_mouse_time) <= 0.1,
              unhighlighted_params = list(alpha = 0.2, fill = NA)) +
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = human_symbol), 
                  # color = "red",
                  max.overlaps = 20, force_pull = 4, size = 3, 
                  data = cov_genes_FIT_training %>% 
                    filter(abs(mean_human_time) <= 0.1, 
                             abs(mean_mouse_time) <= 0.1) %>%  
                    arrange(-abs(cov)) %>% 
                    slice_head(n = 10)) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(title = "Which genes do not vary in both human and mouse?",
       subtitle = "Top 10 genes with highest covariance. Mean cutoff < 0.1")
  

#Plot all
genes_vary_mouse + genes_vary_human + genes_vary_mouse_human + genes_notvary_mouse_human +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", axes = "collect", axis_titles =  "collect",
              ncol =  2)
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
row_clustered = oraGO_all_cov_all_conditions %>% 
    dplyr::select(condition, description, log_q) %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = "condition",
                values_from= "log_q") %>%

    as.matrix() %>% 
    replace(is.na(.), 0) %>%

oraGO_all_cov_all_conditions %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  # filter(p_adjust < 0.01) %>% 
  filter(description %in% c(row_clustered$labels)) %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>% 
  arrange(p_adjust) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 10) %>% 
  select(condition, description, log_q, p_adjust, everything()) %>% 
    mutate(signific = case_when(p_adjust <= 0.10 ~ "*",
                              p_adjust <= 0.25 ~ "-",
                              p_adjust <= 0.50 ~ "/",
                              p_adjust <= 0.05 ~ "**",
                              TRUE ~ "")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = fct_relevel(condition, "Vary in mouse, mean > 0.1", 
                                 "Vary in human, mean > 0.1", 
                                 "Vary in Mouse and Human, mean > 0.1"
                                 )) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=fct_rev(condition), y = description, fill = log_q)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = count),
             pch = 21) +
  geom_text(aes(label = signific), size = 4, vjust = 0.5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(20)) +
    theme_minimal() + 
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 8) ,
          axis.line  = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1),

          # panel.grid = element_blank(), 
          plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 2, 2, unit = "cm"),
          legend.direction = "vertical",
          legend.position = "left") +
    labs(x = "",
         y = "",
         title = "Top 5 enriched genes, ORA") +
    scale_y_discrete(position = "right")
```

```{r}


df_mouse = AllData_V2.0_blood %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  select(csp_id, mm_entrez, hs_entrez, fc_hs, fc_mm) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("del") %>% 
  select(csp_id, mm_entrez, fc_mm)
  
df_human = AllData_V2.0_blood %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  select(csp_id, mm_entrez, hs_entrez, fc_hs, fc_mm) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("del") %>% 
  select(csp_id, hs_entrez, fc_hs)
```






### Single gene


```{r}
X_all <- df_mouse %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = mm_entrez, values_from = fc_mm) %>%
  arrange(csp_id) %>% 
  select(-csp_id) 

y_target_all <- df_human %>%
  arrange(csp_id) %>% 
  select(csp_id, hs_entrez, fc_hs) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = hs_entrez, values_from = fc_hs) %>% 
  select(-csp_id) 

cor_matrix <- cor(X_all, y_target_all, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

cor_values = as.data.frame(cor_matrix) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("mm_entrez")


cor_values

```



```{r}
target_gene <- "26119"

X <- df_mouse %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = mm_entrez, values_from = fc_mm) %>%
  arrange(csp_id)

y_target <- df_human %>%
  filter(hs_entrez == target_gene) %>%
  select(csp_id, fc_hs) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(csp_id)

full_df <- inner_join(X, y_target, by = "csp_id")  %>% 
  select(csp_id, fc_hs, everything()) %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0)))

train_df = full_df

# Correlation
top_genes <- cor_values %>% 
  select(mm_entrez, target_gene = target_gene) %>%
  slice_max(abs(target_gene), n = 100) %>% 
  pull(mm_entrez)

train_df <- full_df %>%
  select(all_of(c("csp_id", "fc_hs", top_genes))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0)))

# Split into train and test
set.seed(123)
data_split <- initial_split(train_df, prop = 0.8)
train_data <- training(data_split)
test_data <- testing(data_split)
train_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, repeats = 5)

# Recipe
rec <- recipe(fc_hs ~ ., data = train_data) %>%
  update_role(csp_id, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_normalize(all_predictors())
```



```{r}
rf_model <- rand_forest(mtry = tune(), trees = 500) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "permutation") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(rec) %>%
  add_model(rf_model)

mer_metrics <- metric_set(yardstick::rmse,
                          yardstick::rsq)


#Cross validation
set.seed(234)
trees_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 5)

doParallel::registerDoParallel()

rf_tuned <- tune_grid(
  wf,
  metrics = mer_metrics,
  resamples = trees_folds,
  grid = 20
)


# Check
rf_tuned %>%
  collect_metrics() %>%
  ggplot()+
  aes(x = mtry, y = mean, colour = .metric, label = mtry) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_label() +
  scale_color_npg()+
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 12)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(.metric), scales = "free")

best_model <- select_best(rf_tuned, metric = "rmse")

# 6. Finalizar e avaliar
final_wf <- finalize_workflow(wf, best_model)
final_fit <- fit(final_wf, train_data)

preds <- predict(final_fit, test_data) %>%
  bind_cols(test_data)

metrics(preds, truth = fc_hs, estimate = .pred)


# Extraia o modelo ajustado diretamente
final_model <- extract_fit_parsnip(final_fit)$fit

library(vip)
# Gere o gráfico de importância
vip(final_model, num_features = 20)

vip_df <- vi(final_model) %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance)) %>% 
  mutate(hs_entrez = target_gene)

head(vip_df, 10)

```



##### Lasso regression
```{r}
# Modelo LASSO
lasso_model <- linear_reg(penalty = tune(), mixture = 1) %>%  # mixture = 1 → LASSO
  set_engine("glmnet") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

# Workflow
wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(rec) %>%
  add_model(lasso_model)

# Cross-validation
set.seed(234)
lasso_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 5)

# Grid de valores de lambda
lambda_grid <- grid_regular(penalty(range = c(-4, 0)), levels = 20)  # log10 scale

# Métricas
mer_metrics <- metric_set(rmse, rsq)

# Tuning
lasso_tuned <- tune_grid(
  wf,
  resamples = lasso_folds,
  metrics = mer_metrics,
  grid = lambda_grid
)

# Selecionar melhor modelo
best_model <- select_best(lasso_tuned, metric = "rmse")


# Check
lasso_tuned %>%
  collect_metrics() %>%
  ggplot()+
  aes(x = penalty, y = mean, colour = .metric, label = penalty) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_label() +
  scale_color_npg()+
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 12)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(.metric), scales = "free")


# Extrair métricas
best_metrics <- lasso_tuned %>%
  collect_metrics() %>%
  filter(penalty == best_model$penalty)

rmse_val <- best_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "rmse") %>% pull(mean)
rsq_val  <- best_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "rsq")  %>% pull(mean)

# Finalizar e ajustar o modelo
final_wf <- finalize_workflow(wf, best_model)
final_fit <- fit(final_wf, train_data)
final_model <- extract_fit_parsnip(final_fit)$fit


# Gere o gráfico de importância
library(vip)
vip(final_model, num_features = 20)

vip_df <- vi(final_model) %>%
```

### Multiple genes


#### Random forest
```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(vip)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

model_rf_by_gene <- function(target_gene, df_mouse, df_human, top_n = 50) {
  
  rf_model <- rand_forest(mtry = tune(), trees = 500) %>%
    set_engine("ranger", importance = "permutation") %>%
    set_mode("regression")
  
  wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(rec) %>%
    add_model(rf_model)
  
  # CV
  set.seed(234)
  trees_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 5)
  mer_metrics <- metric_set(rmse, rsq)
  
  rf_tuned <- tune_grid(
    wf,
    metrics = mer_metrics,
    resamples = trees_folds,
    grid = 5
  )
  
  best_model <- select_best(rf_tuned, metric = "rmse")
  
  # Extraia os valores de RMSE e RSQ do melhor modelo
  best_metrics <- rf_tuned %>%
    collect_metrics() %>%
    filter(mtry == best_model$mtry)
  
  rmse_val <- best_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "rmse") %>% pull(mean)
  rsq_val  <- best_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "rsq")  %>% pull(mean)
  
  final_wf   <- finalize_workflow(wf, best_model)
  final_fit  <- fit(final_wf, train_data)
  final_model <- extract_fit_parsnip(final_fit)$fit
  
  preds <- predict(final_fit, test_data) %>%
  bind_cols(test_data)
  
  metrics_pred = metrics(preds, truth = fc_hs, estimate = .pred)
  
  
  # VIP com métricas adicionadas
  vi(final_model) %>%
    arrange(desc(Importance)) %>%
    mutate(hs_entrez = target_gene,
           rmse = rmse_val,
           rsq = rsq_val)
  
  
  vip_df <- vi(final_model) %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance)) %>% 
  mutate(hs_entrez = target_gene)
  
  results = vip_df %>% inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
               clean_names() %>% 
               select(hs_entrez = human_entrez,
                      hgnc_symbol) %>% 
               mutate(hs_entrez = as.character(hs_entrez)), 
             by = "hs_entrez") %>% 
  rename(mm_entrez = Variable) %>% 
  inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
               clean_names() %>% 
               select(mm_entrez = mouse_ortholog,
                      mm_symbol = mgi_symbol) %>% 
               mutate(mm_entrez = as.character(mm_entrez)), 
             by = "mm_entrez") %>% 
  select(hgnc_symbol, hs_entrez, Importance, mm_symbol, mm_entrez)  %>% 
    arrange(-Importance)
  results
  preds
  metrics_pred
}
```
