#### Lasso

```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)


model_lasso_by_gene <- function(target_gene, X, df_human, top_n = 50, cor_values) {

  y_target <- df_human %>%
    filter(hs_entrez == target_gene) %>%
    select(csp_id, fc_hs) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(csp_id)

  full_df <- inner_join(X, y_target, by = "csp_id") %>%
    select(csp_id, fc_hs, everything()) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0)))

  if (nrow(full_df) < 10) return(NULL)  # ignora se poucos dados

  top_genes <- cor_values %>% 
  select(mm_entrez, target_gene = target_gene) %>%
  slice_max(abs(target_gene), n = 50) %>% 
  pull(mm_entrez)


  train_df <- full_df %>%
    select(all_of(c("csp_id", "fc_hs", top_genes))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0)))

  # Split
  set.seed(123)
  data_split <- initial_split(train_df, prop = 0.8)
  train_data <- training(data_split)
  test_data  <- testing(data_split)

  rec <- recipe(fc_hs ~ ., data = train_data) %>%
    update_role(csp_id, new_role = "id") %>%
    step_normalize(all_predictors())

  # Modelo LASSO
  lasso_model <- linear_reg(penalty = tune(), mixture = 1) %>%
    set_engine("glmnet") %>%
    set_mode("regression")

  wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(rec) %>%
    add_model(lasso_model)

  set.seed(234)
  lasso_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 5)

  lambda_grid <- grid_regular(penalty(range = c(-4, 0)), levels = 20)

  mer_metrics <- metric_set(rmse, rsq)

  lasso_tuned <- tune_grid(
    wf,
    resamples = lasso_folds,
    metrics = mer_metrics,
    grid = lambda_grid
  )

  best_model <- select_best(lasso_tuned, metric = "rmse")

  best_metrics <- lasso_tuned %>%
    collect_metrics() %>%
    filter(penalty == best_model$penalty)

  rmse_val <- best_metrics %>% filter(.metric == "rmse") %>% pull(mean)

  final_wf <- finalize_workflow(wf, best_model)
  final_fit <- fit(final_wf, train_data)
  final_model <- extract_fit_parsnip(final_fit)$fit
  
  
  preds <- predict(final_fit, test_data) %>%
  bind_cols(test_data)
  
  metrics_pred = metrics(preds, truth = fc_hs, estimate = .pred)
  
  
  results = vip_df <- vi(final_model) %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance)) %>% 
  mutate(hs_entrez = target_gene) %>% 
inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
               clean_names() %>% 
               select(hs_entrez = human_entrez,
                      hgnc_symbol) %>% 
               mutate(hs_entrez = as.character(hs_entrez)), 
             by = "hs_entrez") %>% 
  rename(mm_entrez = Variable) %>% 
  inner_join(HS_MM_Symbol_Entrez %>% 
               clean_names() %>% 
               select(mm_entrez = mouse_ortholog,
                      mm_symbol = mgi_symbol) %>% 
               mutate(mm_entrez = as.character(mm_entrez)), 
             by = "mm_entrez") %>% 
  select(hgnc_symbol, hs_entrez, Importance, mm_symbol, mm_entrez) 

return(list(
    results = results,
    metrics_pred = metrics_pred,
    preds = preds
  ))
}

```

```{r}
library(glmnet)
library(tidyverse)
# Simular dados ----------------------------
set.seed(123)

n <- 100  # número de amostras
p <- 20   # número de preditores
k <- 3    # número de respostas

# Matriz X de preditores
X <- matrix(rnorm(n * p), nrow = n, ncol = p)
colnames(X) <- paste0("GeneM", 1:p)

# Gerar matriz Y com relação linear
B <- matrix(c(1.5, -2, 0.5, rep(0, p - 3)), nrow = p, ncol = k)
Y <- X %*% B + matrix(rnorm(n * k), nrow = n)

colnames(Y) <- paste0("GeneH", 1:k)

X
Y
```


```{r}
# Ajuste Lasso multivariado ----------------------------

# Ajuste com validação cruzada para escolher lambda ideal
cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(X, Y, family = "mgaussian", alpha = 1)

# Lambda ideal
best_lambda <- cv_fit$lambda.min
cat("Melhor lambda:", best_lambda, "\n")

# Previsões
preds <- predict(cv_fit, newx = X, s = "lambda.min")

# Converter para tibble
preds_df <- as_tibble(preds[,,1])  # 3D array -> 2D matrix
colnames(preds_df) <- paste0("Pred_", colnames(Y))

# Coeficientes
coefs <- coef(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min")  # Lista com 1 por resposta

# Combinar todos os coeficientes em uma tabela
coef_df <- map2_dfr(coefs, names(coefs), ~ {
  as.matrix(.x) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("Feature") %>%
    rename(Coefficient = 1) %>%
    mutate(Target = .y)
})


# Salvar objetos ----------------------------

write_csv(as_tibble(Y), "Y_true.csv")
write_csv(preds_df, "Y_pred.csv")
write_csv(coef_df, "lasso_coefficients.csv")

saveRDS(cv_fit, "lasso_multivariate_model.rds")

```

```{r}
  bind_rows(degs_pos_neg_mouse_split %>% 
    mutate(quantile_label = if_else(quartiles_diff == "Q100" | 
                                      quartiles_diff == "Q75", "Q75>", 
                                    quartiles_diff)) %>% 
      filter(quantile_label == "Q75>")) %>% 
  arrange(human_symbol, timepoint) %>%
  group_by(human_symbol, quantile_label) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_human_next = lead(mean_human),
    mean_mouse_next = lead(mean_mouse),
    timepoint_next = lead(timepoint),
    direction = paste0("D", timepoint, "→D", timepoint_next)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_human_next), !is.na(mean_mouse_next)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(!(mean_human == mean_human_next & mean_mouse == mean_mouse_next))
  
  

degs_segments
```

## Classification of DEGs: T distributions
```{r}
# Suponha um exemplo
log2fc <- 1.2
ci_low <- 0.8
ci_high <- 1.6
se <- (ci_high - ci_low) / (2 * 1.96)

# Geração de x para a curva
x_vals <- seq(log2fc - 4*se, log2fc + 4*se, length.out = 500)
y_vals <- dnorm(x_vals, mean = log2fc, sd = se)

# Criar o data.frame
df_curve <- data.frame(x = x_vals, y = y_vals)

# Plot
ggplot(df_curve, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(ci_low, ci_high), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2fc, linetype = "solid", color = "black") +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(title = "Normal distribution from log2FC ± CI",
       x = "log2 Fold Change",
       y = "Density")
```


```{r}
#Manual example
dge_long_genes_up_example = dge_long_genes_down%>% 
  filter(organism == "Human",
         symbol == "TLR4") %>% 
  slice(3)

# Parameters
condition = dge_long_genes_up_example$condition
log2fc <- dge_long_genes_up_example$log2fc
# log2fc <- -0.15
ci_low <- dge_long_genes_up_example$ci_low
ci_high <- dge_long_genes_up_example$ci_high
z = dge_long_genes_up_example$z
pval_one_sided = pnorm(z, lower.tail = T) #one sided, higher
se <- dge_long_genes_up_example$se
direction = dge_long_genes_up_example$direction
df <- 120  #samples

# Null parameters
se_null <- se # Same SE
ci_low_null <- 0 - qt(0.975, df) * se_null
ci_high_null <- 0 + qt(0.975, df) * se_null

# x values (scaled for t-distribution)
x_vals <- seq(log2fc - 4*se, log2fc + 4*se, length.out = 500)
x_vals_null <- seq(-4*se, 4*se, length.out = 500)

# t-distribution densities
y_vals <- dt((x_vals - log2fc)/se, df = df) / se
y_vals_null <- dt(x_vals_null / se_null, df = df) / se_null

# Data frames
df_curve_gene <- data.frame(x = x_vals, y = y_vals, distribution = "Observed")
df_curve_null <- data.frame(x = x_vals_null, y = y_vals_null, distribution = "Null")
actual_null_dist <- bind_rows(df_curve_gene, df_curve_null)

# Plot

# Destaque da cauda inferior da distribuição nula
shade_df_superior <- df_curve_null %>%
  filter(x >= log2fc) 

shade_df_inferior <- df_curve_gene %>%
  filter(x <= log2fc) 

ggplot(actual_null_dist, aes(x = x, y = y, color = distribution)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  
  # Área sombreada da cauda superior
  geom_area(data = shade_df_superior, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = "black", alpha = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  # Área sombreada da cauda inferior
  geom_area(data = shade_df_inferior, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  # Linhas de referência
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(ci_high_null), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(ci_low), linetype = "dashed", color = "lightblue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2fc, linetype = "solid", color = "lightblue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black") +
  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(title = paste0(condition, ", ", "adj_pval = ", as.character(pval_one_sided), ", ", direction),
       subtitle = condition,
       x = "log2 Fold Change",
       y = "Density") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Observed" = "lightblue", "Null" = "black"))

```


Automated
```{r}

#Plot T distributions
plot_t_distribution <- function(df, df_samples = 10, n_points = 500) {
  # df: data frame containing condition, log2fc, ci_low, ci_high, se columns
  # df_samples: degrees of freedom for t-distribution (default 120)
  # n_points: number of points for the curves
  
  # Function to create a plot for one row (one condition)
  create_plot <- function(row) {
    condition <- row$condition
    log2fc <- row$log2fc
    ci_low <- row$ci_low
    ci_high <- row$ci_high
    se <- row$se
    adj_p_val = row$adj_p_val
    direction = row$direction
    df <- df_samples
    
    
    # Null parameters (mean=0, same SE)
    se_null <- se
    ci_low_null <- 0 - qt(0.975, df) * se_null
    ci_high_null <- 0 + qt(0.975, df) * se_null
    
    # x ranges for observed and null
    x_vals <- seq(log2fc - 4*se, log2fc + 4*se, length.out = n_points)
    x_vals_null <- seq(-4*se_null, 4*se_null, length.out = n_points)
    
    # t-distribution densities
    y_vals <- dt((x_vals - log2fc) / se, df = df) / se
    y_vals_null <- dt(x_vals_null / se_null, df = df) / se_null
    
    # Data frames for plotting
    df_curve_gene <- data.frame(x = x_vals, y = y_vals, distribution = "Observed")
    df_curve_null <- data.frame(x = x_vals_null, y = y_vals_null, distribution = "Null")
    actual_null_dist <- bind_rows(df_curve_gene, df_curve_null)
    
    # Plot
    p <- ggplot(actual_null_dist, aes(x = x, y = y, color = distribution)) +
      geom_line(size = 1.2) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(ci_high_null), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(ci_low), linetype = "dashed", color = "lightblue") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = log2fc, linetype = "solid", color = "lightblue") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black") +
      theme_vaxgo() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
            legend.position = "top") +
      labs(title = paste0(condition, ", ", "adj_pval = ", round(adj_p_val, 4), ", ", direction),
           x = "log2 Fold Change",
           y = "Density") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Observed" = "lightblue", "Null" = "black"))
    
    return(p)
  }
  
  # Apply the plotting function to each row
  plots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) create_plot(df[i, ]))
  
  # Optionally, name the list by conditions
  names(plots) <- df$condition
  
  return(plots)
}
```


```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=12}

  filter(symbol == "TLR8") %>%
  distinct(condition, .keep_all = TRUE)  # One row per condition

plots_list <- plot_t_distribution(df_example, df_samples = 100)

wrap_plots(plots_list, guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(title = df_example$symbol, theme = theme(legend.position = "top"))
```
